metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: ATOPIK crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C77 H122 Co3 Gd1 N1 O20 P2,C5 H10 O2,3(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Gd01 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Co02 (Co) has 4 O neighbors; Co03 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co04 (Co) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.260-3.561 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 99.84-113.10°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Co3Gd(R″PO3)2(tBuCO2)5(CH3CN)(H2O)4]·tBuCO2H·3CH3CN (R″ = 9-(sec-butyl)-2,7-di-tert-butyl-9H-fluoren-9-yl). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)). Article name explicitly identifies Gd(III).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
